@documentation.@title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 information security management system records
@documentation.@description: A LinkML model of the records an organization keeps to run an information security management system (ISMS) to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 with Amendment 1:2024: its context and scope, policies, roles and objectives, risks and their treatment, its controls and Statement of Applicability, the support and operation it needs, its audits and management reviews, and its nonconformities, corrective actions and improvements. The 93 reference controls of Annex A appear by their numbers alone.

@documentation.@comment: One entry of the Statement of Applicability, which either includes a control or excludes an Annex A control, and says why.

@properties.entry_annex_a_control: The Annex A control a Statement of Applicability entry concerns.
@properties.entry_type: The kind of entry: IsmsIncludedControl or IsmsExcludedControl.
@properties.entry_justification: Why the control is included or excluded.

@documentation.@comment: An item in the inventory of information and other associated assets: what it is, who owns and looks after it, where it is, how it is classified and how much it matters.

@properties.relevant_controls: The organization's controls that the record concerns.

@properties.asset_criticality: How much the asset matters, in the organization's own terms.
